passage.text: Welcome to our language school, Nam!
passage.reading: ˈwɛlkəm tə aʊr ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˌskuːl, ˈnɑːm!

passage.text: Your English course begins on Monday, June 2nd, at 6:30 p.m.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌkɔːrs bɪˈɡɪnz ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, ˈdʒuːn ˈsɛkənd, ət ˈsɪks ˈθɜːrti ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: Your class is in Room 4 on the second floor.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈklæs ɪz ɪn ˈruːm ˈfɔːr ɑːn ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈflɔːr.

passage.text: Please come early on the first day and pay at the front desk.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈkʌm ˈɜːrli ɑːn ðə ˌfɜːrst ˈdeɪ ənd ˈpeɪ ət ðə ˌfrʌnt ˈdɛsk.

passage.text: You need one photo for your member card.
passage.reading: juː ˈniːd ˈwʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ fər jʊr ˈmɛmbər ˌkɑːrd.
